title: Trace Functions
text: constructor seasonality functions drawn generalized family involving trigonometric functions returned make_function.sin associated makepar_F_sin returns functions form: \[S(t) =  c\left(1 + \epsilon + \sin\left(\frac{2 \pi (t-\tau)}{365}\right)\right)^p\] \(c\) norm normalizing constant \(\tau\) phase sets timing peak \(\epsilon \geq 0\) bottom shape parameter: increasing values \(\epsilon\) reduces variance \(p \geq 0\) pw shape parameter. default normalizing constant \(365\) \(S\) multiplied constant, \(m,\) average daily value function year \(1.\)   function can return vector \(N\) functions, one configured \(N=1\)  shape parameters make easy configure seasonality function range features:
code: p1 = makepar_F_sin() S1 <- make_function(p1) integrate(S1, 0, 365)$val ## [1] 365 tt <- seq(0, 3*365, by=5) plot(tt, S1(tt), type ="l", xlab = "Time (in Days)", ylab = expression(S(t))) p2 = makepar_F_sin(phase=120) S2 <- make_function(p2) plot(tt, S1(tt), type ="l", xlab = "Time (in Days)", ylab = expression(S(t))) lines(tt, S2(tt), col = "blue") p3 = makepar_F_sin(phase = c(0,120), N=2) S3 <- make_function(p3) s3 <- S3(tt)  plot(tt, s3[1,], type ="l", xlab = "Time (in Days)", ylab = expression(S(t))) lines(tt, S1(tt), col = "yellow", lty=2) lines(tt, s3[2,], col = "blue") lines(tt, S2(tt), col = "orange", lty=2) p4 <- makepar_F_sin(bottom=.5) p5 <- makepar_F_sin(bottom=2) p6 <- makepar_F_sin(pw=3) p7 <- makepar_F_sin(pw=6) S4 <- make_function(p4) S5 <- make_function(p5) S6 <- make_function(p6) S7 <- make_function(p7) clrs = turbo(7) plot(tt, S7(tt), type ="n", xlab = "Time (in Days)", ylab = expression(S(t))) lines(tt, S1(tt), col = clrs[1]) lines(tt, S4(tt), col = clrs[2]) lines(tt, S5(tt), col = clrs[3]) lines(tt, S6(tt), col = clrs[5]) lines(tt, S7(tt), col = clrs[7]) text(1000, 3.5, expression(p==6), col=clrs[7]) text(1000, 3, expression(p==3), col=clrs[5]) text(1000, 2.5, expression(epsilon==0.5), col=clrs[2]) text(1000, 2, expression(epsilon==2), col=clrs[3])

title: Make a Time Series Function — make_ts_function
text: Build function generates time series known functions. value variable \(x(t)\) computed product four configurable elements: \(\bar x\): mean value \(S(t)\): seasonal pattern \(T(t)\): trend \(K(t)\): shock $$x(t) = \bar x \times S(t) \times T(t) \times K(t)$$ component functions specified passing parameters make_function: season_par creates \(S(t)\) F_season (eg, using makepar_F_sin) trend_par creates \(T(t)\) F_trend (eg, using makepar_F_spline) shock_par creates \(K(t)\) F_shock (eg, using makepar_F_sharkbite)
